description: A PHP source file defining a database driver class for IBM DB2 using ODBC within the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes methods for server info retrieval, metadata, locking, date formatting, and record set handling specific to DB2 via ODBC.

classes.name: ADODB_ODBC_DB2
classes.description: Class representing a DB2 database connection via ODBC, extending ADODB_odbc with DB2-specific properties and methods.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_db2
classes.description: Record set class for handling query results from DB2 via ODBC, extending ADORecordSet_odbc with DB2-specific data types.

methods.name: ADODB_DB2
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_ODBC_DB2 class; sets cursor mode on Windows and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information and driver description for the DB2 ODBC driver.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Returns the last inserted identity value using a specific SQL query.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table for update.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about tables in the database, filtered by type and schema.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table, including primary key details.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates an SQL string to format dates in DB2 using a specified format.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset for pagination.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps generic data types to DB2-specific type codes.
